instruction: A candid full-shot photograph captures a contemporary dance rehearsal in a studio with dark walls and a polished wooden floor. In the foreground left, the man in the rust-colored shirt (R1) stands barefoot with his back to the camera, holding the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) in a close embrace, her yellow-sleeved arms wrapped around his back. In the background right, the man in the rust-colored shirt (R3) stands barefoot in profile, embracing the woman in the yellow shirt (R4). Both couples are captured mid-movement, creating a sense of intimate, synchronized flow. The scene is illuminated by soft overhead light, highlighting the warm tones of the wooden floor and the dancers' rust and yellow attire.
